url.label: URL
url.description: Optional. Qualified URL of the Qdrant instance.Example: https://xyz-example.eu-central.aws.cloud.qdrant.io:6333

grpc_port.label: GPRC Port
grpc_port.description: Optional. Port of the gRPC interface.

prefer_gprc.label: Prefer GRPC
prefer_gprc.description: Optional. Whether to use gPRC interface whenever possible in custom methods.

https.label: HTTPS
https.description: Optional. Whether to use HTTPS(SSL) protocol.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: Optional. Prefix to the REST URL path.Example: `service/v1` will result in http://localhost:6333/service/v1/{qdrant-endpoint} for REST API.
